name: manual_0243b4
claim: Verify the verifier before trusting a green result. A mutation test proves nothing unless the mutation demonstrably changed the guarded text, so assert the replacement count before reading the outcome; freeze the files while independent reviewers read them, because a review of a half-edited state reports false defects; and treat a read-only reviewer that cannot run tests as reading evidence only, so the author supplies the execution evidence.

decisions.notes: In the lockstep conflict-scan remediation, a first mutation check only appended a space that the hash normalization ignored and stayed green, two further mutations matched no text, and a Codex reviewer flagged a wrong pinned hash only because the block was edited after its review began. Reviewers in read-only sandboxes could not run pytest. Asserting the match count, freezing files during review, and running the tests as the author exposed all three.
